lines.text: Israel broke the yoke, saying 'I will not serve,' though the LORD had planted them like a choice vine.
Though Israel washes with lye and soap, the stain of guilt remains, and she is a swift young lioness.
Israel and its kings call a tree their father, and the LORD says let their gods save them.
The LORD says Israel will be disappointed by Egypt just as she was by Babylon.
Israel defiled the land with her prostitution, so the showers were withheld, yet she refuses to be ashamed.
